steps.explanation: Undo the last commit but keep its changes staged.

steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__gitgood.actions.openCommandPalette('undo last commit keep changes'); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !window.__gitgood.store.get().nlPalette.plan; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const plan = s.nlPalette.plan; return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: s.dialog && s.dialog.kind, stepCount: plan ? plan.steps.length : 0, mappedAction: plan ? plan.steps[0].mappedAction : null, risk: plan ? plan.steps[0].risk : null, executable: plan ? plan.steps[0].executable : null }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.runPalettePlan(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const dialog = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog; if (dialog && dialog.kind === 'confirm') await dialog.onConfirm(); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !window.__gitgood.store.get().nlPalette.completed.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ completed: s.nlPalette.completed, failedStep: s.nlPalette.failedStep, headSubject: (await window.__gitgood.invoke('repo.history', __REPO_PATH__, { ref: null, skip: 0, limit: 1, path: null, search: null, follow: false })).commits[0].summary, statusFiles: (await window.__gitgood.invoke('repo.status', __REPO_PATH__)).files.map((f) => f.path) }); })()
(async () => { const h = window.__gitgood.store.get().nlPalette.history; return JSON.stringify(h.map((e) => ({ request: e.request, completed: e.completed, failedStep: e.failedStep }))); })()
